claims.claim: A mineral is a naturally occurring inorganic element or compound with an orderly internal structure and characteristic chemical composition, crystal form, and physical properties.
A rock is an aggregate of one or more minerals, or a body of undifferentiated mineral matter.
The ordered internal structure of a crystalline solid is a definite repeating arrangement of its particles.
Quartz is crystalline silicon dioxide, while rapidly cooled molten silicon dioxide can form amorphous fused silica rather than an ordered crystalline solid.
Color alone is not a reliable identification property for most minerals because a mineral can occur in more than one color and different minerals can share a color.
Minerals are building blocks of rocks, and quartz, feldspar, mica, amphibole, olivine, and calcite are common mineral examples.
